correctness.rationale: The exact deletion and link at the middle vertex are proved face-by-face; the ordinary double-star link is a double suspension of a known simplex skeleton via a contractible base; deletion is a join of star complexes. The inclusion is null by a strict connectivity estimate, producing the explicit wedge splitting in all ranges. Boundary checks cover r=1, r=2, and the entire simplex range. Independent augmented-chain mod-two enumeration checked 117 cases and 36,352 faces; general integral correctness rests on the proof.

value.rationale: A natural one-edge subdivision of the double-star centre breaks the fully-whiskered setting and creates two independent homological sphere dimensions with a gap of r for 3≤r≤min(a,b). The formula gives exact integral homotopy and Betti ranks for all parameters, a structural classification not obtainable from qualitative vertex decomposability alone.
